title: Neural-BEMT
summary: A clean-room blade element-momentum solver that handles propellers and wind turbines in one codebase, with kappa-form iteration and a pluggable loss-factor registry.

title: FlowVFP
summary: A modern front end for a viscous full-potential transonic solver, built to make a legacy research code usable inside a conceptual design loop.

title: Boundary-Aware Conservative Neural Operator
summary: A neural operator on induced point graphs that respects boundary conditions and conservation, aimed at learning PDE solutions without discarding the physics.

title: 2D Euler solver
summary: A finite-volume solver for the two-dimensional Euler equations in C++, written to understand shock capturing from the discretisation up rather than from a manual.

title: py-PlotRes
summary: An interactive dashboard for turning solver residual and force histories into publication-quality plots without rewriting a matplotlib script every time.
